## BeginWorkspaceSignIn

`POST /spin.v1.AuthService/BeginWorkspaceSignIn`

A sign-in on a workspace's host, done by the dashboard. The proxy begins it and sends the browser to the dashboard, which approves it for whoever is signed in there and sends the browser back with a one-time code; the proxy completes it with that code and the binding it gave the same browser. The identity provider is only ever told the dashboard's callback.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `host` | string | The workspace's host the browser asked for, as the proxy received it: &lt;name>.ws.&lt;domain>. The code comes back to this host and to no other. |
| `returnPath` | string | Where on that host the browser goes once it is signed in: a path, never a URL. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `approveUrl` | string | The dashboard's page that approves this sign-in, for the browser to be sent to. |
| `binding` | string | A secret for the browser that began this sign-in, kept where only the proxy reads it: CompleteWorkspaceSignIn requires it with the code, so a code opened in another browser - one somebody was sent a link to - signs nobody in. |

## CheckDeviceLogin

`POST /spin.v1.AuthService/CheckDeviceLogin`

Check device login status (CLI polls this) Returns session token once user has completed login and entered the code

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `deviceCode` | string | The device_code from StartDeviceLogin |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | [DeviceLoginStatus](/reference/api/types/#deviceloginstatus) | Status of the device login |
| `user` | [User](/reference/api/types/#user) | Only set when status is DEVICE_LOGIN_STATUS_COMPLETE |
| `sessionToken` | string |  |
| `expiresAt` | `Timestamp` |  |

## GetCurrentUser

`POST /spin.v1.AuthService/GetCurrentUser`

Get current user info

**Request**

No fields: `{}`.

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | [User](/reference/api/types/#user) |  |
| `controlPlaneVersion` | string | The release of the control plane that answered, which is the release of the dashboard asking: the bundle is served from inside that binary. ## StartDeviceLogin

`POST /spin.v1.AuthService/StartDeviceLogin`

Start device login flow (for CLI when OAuth redirect is not available) Returns a user code and verification URL. User visits URL and enters code.

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `identityProviderId` | string | Optional: use default if empty |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `deviceCode` | string | Secret code for CLI to poll with |
| `userCode` | string | Short code user enters (e.g., "ABCD-1234") |
| `verificationUrl` | string | URL user visits to login |
| `expiresIn` | integer (int32) | Seconds until codes expire |
| `interval` | integer (int32) | Seconds between poll attempts |

## StartLogin

`POST /spin.v1.AuthService/StartLogin`

Start login flow with a specific identity provider Use "github" for built-in GitHub auth, or IdP ID for dynamic providers

**Request**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `identityProviderId` | string | ID of the identity provider to use |
| `redirectUri` | string | Where the identity provider sends the code: the dashboard's /auth/callback, over https. Anything else is refused. |

**Response**

| Field | Type | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `authUrl` | string | URL to redirect user to |
| `state` | string | CSRF state token |
| `binding` | string | A secret for the client that began this sign-in, and for nobody else: CompleteLogin requires it with the state. The state and the code come back in a URL, which somebody who signed in to their own account can send to anybody - and without this, whoever opens it is signed in as them. Kept where only this client reads it, never in a URL. |
